name: crowdsec-decisions
description: CrowdSec's decided half (threat detection engine): one Local API container holding decisions, fed from files and journald rather than from this product's store, plus a bouncer that asks the platform before it blocks anything and may never block the VPN path, the LAN gateway or the ISP ranges without a human (auto-block authority). Its community blocklist needs a registered machine key, so it stays off until the operator opts in (community blocklist dependency).
if_disabled: No decision from this feed arrives and nothing is blocked on one; Sigma detections, incidents and notifications are unaffected because nothing in the platform depended on it being present.
